part.text:
Fixed. The issue was that `--map-syntax` glob mappings were only checked against the full file name, never against the file name with ignored suffixes stripped, so `*.demo` could never match `foo.demo.example`.

Changes:

- src/syntax_mapping.rs:193 — `get_syntax_for` now, after failing to match the name as-is, recursively retries the glob mappings on the path with an ignored suffix stripped (e.g. `foo.demo.example` → `foo.demo`), so `--map-syntax "*.demo:YAML"` matches `foo.demo.example` when `--ignored-suffix ".example"` is given. Chained suffixes (`test.demo.foo.suffix`) also work via recursion.
- src/syntax_mapping/ignored_suffixes.rs:43 — made `strip_suffix`/`try_with_stripped_suffix` lifetimes generic to allow borrowing from arbitrary path arguments.

Validation:
- `cargo test`: all suites pass (95 integration tests including the new `map_syntax_and_ignored_suffix_work_together`, 46 unit tests, 0 failures).
- Manual check: `bat foo.demo.example --map-syntax "*.demo:YAML" --ignored-suffix ".example"` now highlights as YAML.
- `cargo fmt --check` clean.
